en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a tree‑lined dirt road leading to a railway station building. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk along the road, and a cyclist rides on a parallel path. The station building is partly visible on the right. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner, and a handwritten year is added beneath it. A cursive signature or publisher credit is printed in the lower right.
